title: Bloom's Ladder: Six Levels, Measurable Verbs
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A six-step staircase of the revised Bloom taxonomy with measurable verbs and an example objective for each level, plus a panel on matching outcomes to activities.

educational.topic: The six levels of the revised Bloom taxonomy and their measurable verbs
learningObjectives: The learner will name the six levels of the revised Bloom taxonomy in order and match measurable verbs to their levels.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What verb does this outcome use?
Do the activities ask for the same level?
commonMisconceptions: Higher levels matter more than lower ones
Bloom's taxonomy is a pyramid with fewer outcomes at the top
assessmentOpportunities: Which level asks learners to put parts together into something new?
An outcome says "predict" and every activity asks only for recall. What is wrong?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
